kind: first-party baseline (own game); not a third-party capture

method.determinism: Page booted without ?autoplay; in ONE synchronous evaluate the match is configured through the page's own controls (difficulty button, venue toolbar button, Auto toggle) and launched with TennisMenu.launch(); window.advanceTime(1000/60) is then called once per step so the real-time rAF loop never interleaves (the first advanceTime switches the game to manual stepping). The sim is seeded from game time/serve counters only (no Date.now/Math.random in match-engine.js); audio and tournament code use Math.random but never touch sim state.
couplings: autoplay and serve-phase player movement/assist-swing live in the Aura3D adapter (stepTopTennisPlayerControl, called from renderer.render once per render): extra renders (window resize, venue change) advance that logic too
render() is called once per advanceTime(); the port must keep one render per step to reproduce autoplay
method.viewport: 320x180 for state sessions (render cost is irrelevant to the sim)
